name: Ulauncher Theme Synchronizer
description: Synchronize Ulauncher with your OS appearance

preferences.name: Auto Theme
preferences.description: Shows the current theme sync status.

preferences.name: Light Theme
preferences.description: Theme name to use in light mode. Must match a folder in ~/.config/ulauncher/user-themes/ or a built-in theme name.

preferences.name: Dark Theme
preferences.description: Theme name to use in dark mode. Must match a folder in ~/.config/ulauncher/user-themes/ or a built-in theme name.
